title: Build dist snapshot env var can recursively delete arbitrary paths
description: tools/build-cli-dist.mjs resolves BOREAL_BUILD_DIST_SNAPSHOT_DIR from the ambient environment and, when set to anything other than the normal distRoot, immediately rm -rf deletes that resolved path before copying the build output. A poisoned environment can therefore make pnpm build remove an arbitrary writable tree such as a checkout, parent directory, or symlink target.
acceptanceCriteria: BOREAL_BUILD_DIST_SNAPSHOT_DIR is either confined to a controlled temporary/staging root or requires an explicit unsafe opt-in before deletion.
The build script rejects cwd, repo root, repo ancestors, home, filesystem root, and symlink escapes before rm is called.
Regression tests cover unsafe snapshot env values and one valid temp snapshot directory.
